form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Kennedy (for himself, Mrs. Hyde-Smith, Mr. Rubio, and Mr. Cassidy) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To reauthorize the National Flood Insurance Program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the NFIP Extension Act of 2022.

section.header: Reauthorization of national flood insurance program

subsection.text: Section 1309(a) of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4016(a)) is amended by striking September 30, 2022 and inserting September 30, 2023.
Section 1319 of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4026) is amended by striking September 30, 2022 and inserting September 30, 2023.
If this Act is enacted after September 30, 2022, the amendments made by subsections (a) and (b) shall take effect as if enacted on September 30, 2022.
